background_setting: A quiet two-lane rural highway stretching straight toward a distant horizon under a clear blue daytime sky. Flat open terrain with dry grass, sparse low vegetation, and scattered fields flank both sides of the road. The pavement is a faded gray asphalt covered with a tangle of black tar-sealant crack repairs and dark tire skid marks that meander along and across the ego lane, while crisp white lane lines run straight along the road's edges. A textured rumble strip lines the right shoulder, beyond which lies a gravel margin. The road ahead is entirely clear of traffic.

lighting.direction: High sun, slightly front-left, producing consistent directional light
lighting.shadows: Short, consistent shadows cast to the right of raised features like the rumble strip; tar snakes appear glossy where the sun catches them
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast illumination that sharply defines the white lane lines and makes the dark tar snakes stand out against the lighter pavement

aesthetics.composition: Centered one-point perspective with the road converging at a vanishing point on the horizon; the ego lane fills the lower-center frame, sky occupies the upper third
aesthetics.color_scheme: Gray asphalt, glossy black tar lines, crisp white lane markings, dry tan roadside, and clear blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Meandering black tar snake lines and the repeating indentations of the rumble strip

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking dashcam motion following the vehicle's path, with a rightward drift and deceleration in the final segment; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's ego perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the road surface, lane lines, and tar snakes throughout

context: Autonomous driving perception failure demonstration where the vehicle misinterprets tar sealant snakes as lane edges

actions.description: The ego vehicle travels straight and steady along the two-lane highway, tar snakes streaming toward the camera. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues forward as tar snakes wander across the lane; subtle rightward hesitation begins as the system misreads the tar lines as lane edges. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle swerves toward the right shoulder near the rumble strip and slows sharply, holding the decelerated drift for the final segment. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam shows a clear two-lane highway under bright daylight, the ego lane laced with meandering black tar-sealant snakes and dark skid marks, straight white lane lines running along both edges. Through 0:01-0:02 the vehicle cruises steadily forward as the tar snakes wander across the pavement and stream toward the camera. Around 0:03 the vehicle begins to hesitate, misreading the glossy tar lines as lane boundaries, and starts drifting to the right. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle swerves toward the right shoulder near the textured rumble strip and slows sharply, holding this decelerated, off-center position for the final two seconds. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady ambient road and tire hum over asphalt, the low drone of the engine at highway speed. Around the three-second mark, a brief rise in tire-on-rumble-strip vibration as the vehicle drifts right, followed by the pitch of the engine lowering and a faint deceleration whine as the car slows. No speech or music; naturalistic environmental audio throughout.
